reason: A DSH plugin that orchestrates image preprocessing through a configured vision provider so a text-only DeepSeek agent can handle image attachments.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的视觉模型预处理聊天中的图片，并将生成的文字描述传递给文本型 DeepSeek 智能体。
summaries.en: Preprocesses chat image attachments with a configured vision model and passes the resulting descriptions to a text-only DeepSeek agent.

capabilities: Routes chat image attachments to a configured vision provider
Converts image analysis results into text for a DeepSeek conversation
Stores vision provider and model selections in native plugin settings
Uses a bounded process-local cache for successful image descriptions
